wins.label: Strong organic growth
wins.evidence: We generated 7% organic base fee growth and over $650 billion of net inflows over the last 12 months.

wins.label: Record AUM and revenue growth
wins.evidence: We finished the second quarter with record AUM, record units of trust of $12.5 trillion.

wins.label: Successful acquisitions
wins.evidence: We closed our acquisition of HPS Investment Partners, a major milestone as we evolve towards our ambitions of 30% revenue contribution from private markets and technology by 2030.

wins.label: Positive performance in technology services
wins.evidence: Quarterly technology services revenue and subscription revenue was up 26% compared to a year ago.

wins.label: Strong client engagement
wins.evidence: Clients are eager to put more capital to work with BlackRock.

risks.label: Market volatility
risks.evidence: Significant intra-month equity market declines in April were also a contributing factor.

risks.label: Performance fee decline
risks.evidence: Performance fees of $94 million decreased from a year ago, reflecting lower performance revenue from private markets.

risks.label: Higher expenses
risks.evidence: Total expense increased 14% year-over-year, reflecting higher compensation, sales asset and account expense and higher G&A.

risks.label: Regulatory uncertainty
risks.evidence: The actual effective tax rate may differ because of nonrecurring or discrete items or potential changes in tax legislation.

risks.label: Integration challenges
risks.evidence: We are in the process of integrating HPS, GIP, and Preqin, which may pose challenges.

wins.label: Strong Q2 Results
wins.evidence: Second quarter revenue of $5.4 billion was 13% higher year-over-year, driven by the impact of organic growth and higher markets on average AUM, base fee is consolidated in the GIP transaction and higher technology services and subscription revenue, which includes the onboarding of Preqin.

wins.label: Record AUM & Net Inflows
wins.evidence: Record AUM, record units of trust of $12.5 trillion. Generated 7% organic base fee growth and over $650 billion of net inflows over the last 12 months.

wins.label: GIP V Success
wins.evidence: GIP V closed above its $25 billion target, making it the largest private market fund raise in the histories of BlackRock and GIP.

wins.label: HPS Integration
wins.evidence: Closing of HPS Investment Partners added $165 billion of client AUM and $118 billion of fee-paying AUM on July 1.

wins.label: Technology Revenue Growth
wins.evidence: Quarterly technology services revenue and subscription revenue was up 26% compared to a year ago.

risks.label: Low Fee Institutional Redemptions
risks.evidence: Second quarter net inflows of $68 billion were impacted by low fee institutional index redemptions, which saw $48 billion of net outflows.

risks.label: Market & FX Movements
risks.evidence: Estimated base fee run rate approximately 5% higher than total base fees for the second quarter.

risks.label: Performance Fees Decline
risks.evidence: Performance fees of $94 million decreased from a year ago, reflecting lower performance revenue from private markets, liquid alternatives and long-only products.

risks.label: Expense Increases
risks.evidence: Total expense increased 14% year-over-year, reflecting higher compensation, sales asset and account expense and higher G&A.
